text:
maya: Heads-up - GCP partner replied: waitlist 4-6 weeks for new n2d racks. They can prioritize a 'staging' rack if we sign a CCR (committed capacity reservation). Need staging for onboarding new H100 pools. @sam @procurement?

sam: Do we have numbers on CCR cost delta? If it's reasonable we can take a short trial. @jin can you check billing impact?

jin: I'll run a quick calc. Sharing link to pricing docs: https://cloud.google.com/compute/commitments

tolga: Can we ask if they can split racks (1 staging + 2 prod) or do they require contiguous allocation? Prod isolation is important.

vendor-gcp: We can split across zones but staging racks may land in a different host pool; perf variance possible. If prioritized, ETA 3-4 weeks to provision.

procure-bot: Procurement ticket PR-482 opened (assignee: @sam). Please add PO and GL codes.

sam: Opening internal PO now and pinging finance. Will update by EOD.

jin: Quick calc: 6mo CCR gives ~18% unit discount; monthly commit ~12k for one rack. If we do a 3mo staging CCR it's borderline but OK for trial. Recommend 3mo or 6mo if we want steady savings.

maya: If we proceed, reservation command we plan to run:
```bash
gcloud compute reservations create redwood-staging-res \
  --zone=us-west1-b --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --count=8 \
  --commitment=1y
```

rack-bot: Inventory snapshot: us-west1 available racks: 5. Currently allocated to Redwood: 2. Can reserve 1 for staging if PO arrives within 7 days.

sam: Ok, opening vendor contract PR. @maya can you confirm staging test cases so procurement has justification?

maya: Test plan: perf smoke (p99 latency), KV cache warmup, 24h soak to validate cache behavior under TTL churn. I'll paste detailed checklist in PR.

vendor-gcp: We'll hold prioritized slot for 7 days while PO clears. After that the slot will be released back to waitlist.

sam: Noted — pushing finance. If PO doesn't clear we'll lose priority.

maya: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — please add any blockers here.
